dimensions.label: Clarity
dimensions.criterion: Prefer the text that a reader can understand without resolving ambiguity.

dimensions.label: Fluency
dimensions.criterion: Prefer natural connected prose. Penalize awkward or staccato wording.

dimensions.label: Directness
dimensions.criterion: Prefer the text that states useful information sooner. Penalize planning narration and filler.

guards: Do not judge factual accuracy or completeness. Deterministic assertions test those requirements.
Do not judge compliance with a named writing standard.
Use a tie when neither output has a material advantage.
